description: From PR #101 gating audit: the idle spin-down opt-in knob doesn't exist in production — nothing populates the Distributor's :recruitment worker_params (director/server.ex:308 starts the distributor without overrides). Plumb: cluster config (e.g. materializer_idle_timeout_ms) -> director -> Distributor child_spec -> recruitment context worker_params %{"idle_timeout" => ms}. DECIDE the policy asymmetry at the same time: recruited materializers get the timeout, fresh-bootstrap data-shard materializers don't (bootstrap passes no params) — intended or should bootstrap set it for data shards too (never tag 0)? ALSO from audit: mixed-version note — new 4-tuple {:new_worker,id,kind,params} vs old foreman nodes (FunctionClauseError under rolling upgrade); and consider a task-with-timeout wrapper around the pre-spindown sync snapshot upload (hung-S3 wedge).
title: Plumb idle_timeout from cluster config to recruitment worker_params
